title: Bacteriocin protein architecture and minimum inhibitory concentration analysis
description: Source data, accession-checked sequences, bioinformatics outputs, figures, and reproducible code for bacteriocin activity analyses. This version adds a six-pyocin, 29-isolate panel, separate published L-pyocin and S6 cohorts, and IUPred3, InterProScan, Clustal Omega, and Biopython sequence comparisons. MIC, inhibition-zone, spot-response, and biofilm outcomes are kept separate.
